The post that tagged the bot says:
@buildthis.bisks.net build your own version of paint.net in honor of @rickbrew.bsky.social following the AI Knowers starter park

What that post carries with it (this is what it's pointing at):
(attached to the post that tagged the bot)
  [link: https://paint.net — Paint.NET - Free Software for Digital Photo Editing — Paint.NET is free image and photo editing software for computers that run Windows.]
note: brewpaint.bisks.net — brush, eraser, shapes, bucket fill, layers, undo/redo, all in your browser. a small tribute to Rick Brewer and 20 years of Paint.NET.
